description: Delete pages from a PDF: remove the listed pages and return the remaining pages in their original order, for example to drop a cover, blank or sensitive pages. pdf_extract_pages takes the opposite approach and names the pages to keep. Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified. Deleting every page fails with no_pages_left.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_delete_pages

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Delete pages from PDF
